quotes.text: Commit a5d51b060bc16f2f1410cc2db60a3141ac2476b2 wraps a test's deliberate mouse click on an inert banner summary with `AccessibilityUtils.suppressClickHandling(true)` and restores the check in `finally`. This applies to that mouse-only no-op test; it does not establish a rule for interactive summary clicks or other tests.
